text:
tara_ops: vendor update — just got a call from Viktor at Kinetica Logistics. H100 batch scheduled for 3/28 now shows a customs reclassification hold. ETA moving from ~2w to 6–8w unless we pay a reclassification fee. Options: pay expedite (~$28k), request a partial release (up to 40 units) for cross-dock, or accept temporary loaners. Need quick decision. :thinking:

nico_procurement: can you paste the vendor's cost breakdown? how firm is the $28k? we should push for a credit if this was a vendor classification error.

viktor_vendor: confirming — customs flagged an HS-code discrepancy on arrival paperwork. Our import team can either: 1) request expedited reclassification (5–7 business days + admin fee), 2) apply for a partial cross-dock release of non-custom-configured units (up to 40), or 3) reroute to alternate customs entry (longer). The expedite fee estimate includes brokerage and admin: `USD 27,500` (ballpark). Provisional AWB: `KLG123456789`.

ops_lead_alex: if we do a split release, what does cross-dock look like operationally? we don't want double-handling. need staging manifest and explicit handoff SLI.

arnaud_eng: quick capacity note — diverting 40 units to us-east buys us ~3k concurrent tokens for canary traffic. we can run a reduced Dedicated pool for critical customers. Prefer split vs paying full expedite.

maria_sre: routing canary traffic to us-east instead of primary region will add ~10–15ms p99 for those routes. acceptable for canary and internal traffic, not for high-SLA enterprise customers. we should mark traffic and add a fallback route.

nico_procurement: vendor, please confirm whether the HS-code mismatch is from the commercial invoice vs packing list. if it's vendor paperwork, we ask for at least 50% fee credit. hold payment until resolution.

viktor_vendor: under review with our customs broker — if it was our miscoding, we will accept partial responsibility. I can push legal for a 50% credit on the expedite fee if internal error confirmed. I can also issue a partial-release manifest today once you sign cross-dock acceptance. Shipping command we run internally: `label_cmd --create --awb KLG123456789 --to CROSSDOCK-SEA-01 --qty 40`.

shipping-bot: label created for AWB KLG123456789 -> CROSSDOCK-SEA-01. Return label template assigned: `RET-SEA-01-000`. PDF links: https://klog.example/labels/KLG123456789.pdf and https://klog.example/returns/RET-SEA-01-000.pdf

tara_ops: decision for now: 1) nico to hold payment pending vendor credit confirmation, 2) accept partial release (40 units) to CROSSDOCK-SEA-01, 3) arnaud to spin up a temporary reduced Dedicated pool in us-east for canary traffic, 4) shipping-bot to attach return templates to the ops ticket.

nico_procurement: holding payment. vendor, please provide updated invoice and credit note when available, and confirm new payment terms (net30 still ok?).

arnaud_eng: i'll run a quick sim on provisioning impact and set autoscale min for the temp pool. pls send the manifest CSV to me (serials + hw config). we should also soft-limit batch sizes to reduce memory pressure while running mixed generation profiles.

viktor_vendor: manifest emailed to procurement + ops. ETA for cross-dock arrival is 48h after partial release approval. if anything changes i'll update AWB and push a revised label.

tara_ops: i'll open an ops ticket (OPS-4521) for cross-dock acceptance + RMA label flow and link the PDFs from shipping-bot. tagging @shipping-bot to attach return template to the ticket. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
